scope: Alphabetical first24 structural-only entries from cloud-audit-python-tests.json, test_adapters_crewai.py through test_evidence_attestation.py

findings.finding: Two optional-instrumentor tests inherited installed-package availability, making their assertions environment-dependent.
findings.resolution: Explicitly block instrumentor imports except allowed fake OpenAI.28 targeted tests pass; two relevant tests also pass with synthetic installed OpenAI/Anthropic modules injected. No runtime change.

findings.finding: all on last two failed events could accept absent/short added sequence.
findings.resolution: Assert exactly two added events and exact model request/result failed role sequence;28 targeted tests pass.

findings.finding: Unbounded child stdout.readline in byte spool and subprocess.run without timeout in client/closure tests can hang runner before later timeout applies.
findings.resolution: Recorded only; process harness changes not included in authorized narrow test fixes.

findings.finding: Content-ref integration tests compute expected refs by calling store.put after SDK operation; that call can create missing bytes and mask failure to persist original operation.
findings.resolution: Read-only finding; direct ref-file existence/readback before second put would independently prove persistence.

findings.finding: Selected all(values) and set(values) checks do not pin expected named check/gate inventory; empty all or shrunken nonempty set can pass if a runner removes cases.
findings.resolution: Record expected gate/case names before universal success assertions in future test strengthening; existing tests still prove explicitly asserted counters/negative outcomes.

files.test_contract: Duck-typed CrewAI step/task callbacks hash selected thought/log/output/description content, preserve full lengths, prefer modern thought fields, tolerate missing fields and swallow hostile property exceptions. Re-read new callback-error regression: exactly two diagnostic records, no private exception canary or exc_info.
false_pass_risks_and_limits: SimpleNamespace fixtures do not exercise a real CrewAI release or callback registration.
Privacy assertions cover event dictionaries and newly added hostile-error diagnostic canary; no real exporter transport or full sensitive-label canary test.
Agent/tool labels remain raw and are not tested with sensitive values.
files.privacy_closure_error_cases: Strong raw-content canary and digest checks for selected fields; no completion/delivery claims; hostile property failures preserve host execution. New concurrent security-worker regression explicitly excludes exception text from diagnostics; reviewed final patch.
